{"code":"def generate(rng):
    h=rng.randint(3,10)
    w=rng.randint(3,10)
    # Varied sparse ARC-style colored grids with background 0.
    grid=[[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    n=rng.randint(1,max(1,(h*w)//2))
    for _ in range(n):
        r=rng.randrange(h); c=rng.randrange(w)
        grid[r][c]=rng.randint(1,9)
    return grid"}
